lead.headline: The lead is gone: 31.8 behind with only Barkley left
lead.deck: The late games and a 49ers D/ST that allowed 30 turned a 0.4 lead into a 1% chance.
lead.body: Bloodsports led by 0.4 at 16:30. By 17:52 the 49ers D/ST had fallen to 1 point after a 36-30 win over Arizona, Pineiro had 6, and JuiceJam's late players finished. Oronde Gadsden caught none of his three targets. Barkley needs 31.8 on Monday night against a Chicago offence led by third-string Case Keenum, with JuiceJam's Eagles D/ST in the same game. The lineup was the projection lineup.
